name: Asterism
_notes: Copy to 46630.json and edit. Remove these notes and every REPLACE_ value.

The testnet has no official Uniswap V2 deployment (docs/DECISIONS.md D-007). For a rehearsal run scripts/deploy.sh dex-testnet --account <keystore> --broadcast, which deploys a stand-in WETH and V2-compatible factory (test mocks, not Uniswap), and put the two printed addresses here. The launcher refuses addresses without code.
saleStart and saleEnd are unix seconds. saleStart must be more than one hour in the future when you deploy.
mintPriceWei is a JSON number, in wei per whole token.
